# inquiry status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:inquiryStatus`](gmeow-inquiryStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/inquiryStatus>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

The status of a research inquiry, drawn from the [`gmeow:ExecutionStatus`](../classes/gmeow-ExecutionStatus.md) value vocabulary. Applies to Procedures of type researchPlan. Non-functional: competing assessments coexist.
